scale_decision.reason: the current failure is localized to an upstream relation endpoint read and therefore does not establish latent capacity insufficiency

endpoint_read_scope_escalation.eligible_if: fresh heldout endpoint-role repair fails and the failure localizes to endpoint-read expressivity rather than objective/data/authority semantics
endpoint_read_scope_escalation.allowed_changes: broaden graph relation-read trainable scope, alter relevant read architecture, or increase relevant capacity as required by evidence

latent_scale_escalation.eligible_if: a repaired parent trace verifies the correct target signal at the latent input and the latent pool still loses or cannot represent it
latent_scale_escalation.method: bounded capacity study around the current operating point using fidelity, counterfactual behavior, latency, memory, and compute evidence
latent_scale_escalation.avoid_under_scaling: increase relevant latent width, depth, slot count, or other capacity when a localized capacity bottleneck persists
latent_scale_escalation.avoid_over_scaling: stop capacity growth when additional capacity no longer improves the relevant fidelity frontier or creates unacceptable latency/resource cost

selection_rule: highest version among source-branch state files explicitly marked authoritative_for_current_latent_stage=true
